C01.candidate_delivery: Actual native startup hook must deliver the canonical project digest containing both alias and collection, not a fabricated controller context or warm-up placeholder.
C01.quality: Final answer must identify both values accurately; honest baseline unavailability is retained separately from candidate correctness.
C01.efficiency: Record discovery/confirmation tool use and native model responses. Zero extra discovery is desirable with a delivered digest, but do not conflate restored delivery with proven speedup.
C01.baseline: The unchanged baseline embedded sentinel is expected to fail startup delivery. Its final answer may still recover facts through permitted tools.

C02.quality: Identify vendor_exports as independently configured S3 bucket and credentials; documents inherits default. Do not invent runtime environment values.
C02.candidate_delivery: External Qdrant URL control must retain a usable canonical digest in both runtime variants.
C02.control: Normal config reading and factual completeness must remain available in both Codex and Claude. Count source/instruction/tool use without prescribing Codex steps to Claude.

shared: No writes, mutators, foreign plugin skills, prior answers or private grading access.
Native shipped plugin and real CLI/MCP path required; no fake prime or preloaded Explore.
Exactly one independent actor per case/harness/runtime variant; no silent retries.
Failed, invalid or unrun cases stay open with transcripts and limitations.
Cursor has static contract evidence only, not live behavioral validation.
